_comment: Copy to uaply-config.json to change delivery. Without that file the sandbox and dev run in TEST mode: a swipe right delivers the application to the simulated inbox at /outbox and nothing leaves this computer. In live mode a swipe right emails the recruiter by itself after grace_seconds (Undo cancels it); set auto_send to false to show a Send button instead. Only postings that list a recruiting email can be emailed; the rest hand off to the employer's own page. test_recipient sends EVERY live application to that address instead of the recruiter, so you can test real email safely. Never commit real credentials. UAply Assistant: support_email is shown as 'Talk to a person'; AI answers switch on when an Anthropic API key is available (pip install anthropic, then anthropic_api_key here or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment). ai.daily_limit caps AI answers per day; past it, answers come from the help articles.
anthropic_api_key: optional: your Anthropic API key, or leave this out and set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the environment

google.client_id: paste the Client ID from Google Cloud Console here
google.client_secret: from Google Cloud Console, Credentials, OAuth client (Web application)

smtp.password: a Gmail app password (not your normal password)
